mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 32 degrees and overcast at Harriet Park. We are under a Full Moon tonight. The ISS will pass overhead, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight, temperatures will drop to a low of 27 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

Property tax season is here. Bills are arriving by mail, and you can pay in two installments. Payments can be made via the city website using a credit card, at the City Center drop boxes, or in person at the administration office.

We have plenty to do this week. Yoga at Insight Wellness is today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza night at Lake Lou-ee.
In our weekly report, on November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a driver unresponsive in a vehicle, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
Today's flavor is delicious Butter Pecan. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
